versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the VDOT Running Calculator.
- Calculates VDOT score and the five Daniels training paces (Easy, Marathon, Threshold, Interval, Repetition) from one recent race result or goal.
- Uses exact, industry-standard Daniels-Gilbert VO2/velocity and %VO2max equations as used by elite distance coaches.
- Fully self-contained calculation—no external tables or APIs required.
- Provides clear pace ranges and explanation for each training zone, along with essential usage caveats.
